tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.title: Get my Ojusvi profile
tools.description: Read the signed-in user's Ojusvi profile: account type (self or parent), payer name, member name and member phone.

tools.name: update_my_profile
tools.title: Update my Ojusvi profile
tools.description: Update the signed-in user's Ojusvi profile fields (payer name, member name, member phone, account type).

payer_name.description: Name of the person paying / the account holder.

member_name.description: Name of the member using Ojusvi, when paying for a parent.

member_phone.description: Member's phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +919876543210.

account_type.description: Whether the membership is for the payer or a parent.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.title: List Ojusvi membership plans
tools.description: List the available Ojusvi membership plans with price in paise and duration in days.

tools.name: get_my_membership
tools.title: Get my Ojusvi membership
tools.description: Check the signed-in user's Ojusvi membership: plan, status and current period.
